vibe_rationale: Surf film and photography culture at the core across several weeks, curated and community-facing, though narrow and the evidence is thin.
fit_notes: An adult, outdoorsy and creative surf crowd with a plausible active-lifestyle angle, and 27 partners already listed on the sponsors page, including Surfrider Foundation and Surfers 4 Climate.
